entry.description: add a `TransportSecurity` option to the `log4net.Ext.Mail` `SmtpAppender` and make `EnableSsl` a shorthand for it. `EnableSsl` requires transport security, selecting implicit TLS on port 465 and mandatory `STARTTLS` elsewhere, so connecting fails when the server offers no TLS instead of silently continuing in plaintext, as `System.Net.Mail.SmtpClient.EnableSsl` does. Opportunistic `STARTTLS` remains available, but only by asking for it with `TransportSecurity=StartTlsWhenAvailable` (audit 1231d72-f007)
